title: Default gaps are still not perfect enough
body: This is the link where I got it to the closest to perfect https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1111&rotation=-90&turns=0+0%2C-15+15&gaps=0.08+0.07+%7E+%7E%2C0.18+0.18+%7E+%7E Yet looks like 0.07 is still to close as a reference and 0.08 id too much of a gap. Rotation can be ignored for tests, and it works as expected. `turns=0+0%2C-15+15` that looks strange, do we not have 0 as defaults? Do we need to enter zerors? May be we can use some delimeter to just skip first item to make url shorter. Also double check across our history of url changes and we do support all previous urls configuraton as I gave some public links to them, so backward compatibility must be preserved, and if we have a shorter version of the url it should be updated when user comes to the page (with write to history of browser). By default `Gap at the target reference` results in much bigger gap on fully closed self referencing link, meaning 0.08 makes too much of a gap, yet 0.07 is closer to perfection, yet by default they must be exactly the same (must be tested and measured). Something is wrong with switching between 0.07 and 0.08 of this setting, there is sudden jump, yet between 0.00 and 0.07 no such sudden jumps. Also up/down buttons of this configurator should not reset the value to zero (i mean up/down should go in steps of 0.01, not 1, for some reason there is UI bug, I clicked on up or down and got zero instead of 0.07). Also on all sliders and also input fields with numbers we need to double check keyboard arrows work, and double check for all other obvious and intuitive keyboard keys and short cuts are supported. Also experiemental automatic gap in this case didn't end up at this configuration, may it is because we don't set preority to not break fully self closing ling by default. So if link is fully self closed most likely it is already at perfect position or partially closed (the closed part of it is already perfect). By default we should prioritize to changing gaps and angles in this experimental feature for other open ended links. And this exact perfect arrangement should be added to tests. Last time we did nice work at https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/issues/25 on making 0.18 and 0.18 for upper link to land on exactly the same line, but the closed links was not perfected enough or broken. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
